description.name: Enhance
description.tagline: v1.4.0 · Provisioning, single sign-on and client tools for the Enhance control panel.
description.long: Connects WHMCS to the Enhance control panel through its REST API: creates organisations, owner logins, subscriptions and websites, suspends, terminates and changes plans, and gives clients one-click access to the panel, webmail, phpMyAdmin and WordPress. English and European Portuguese.
features: Create, suspend, unsuspend, terminate (soft or hard) and change plan
Single sign-on to the Enhance panel as the organisation owner
Client area: usage, SSL expiry, webmail, phpMyAdmin and WordPress login, backups and optional restore
Step-by-step connection test and per-service last error
Migrates data from the official Enhance module and earlier versions
